title: Indian Army Agniveer GD Full Length Mock Test 17 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for Indian Army Agniveer GD (CEE). 100 Questions | 60 Minutes | Advanced challenging questions based on latest pattern.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 100 questions (General Knowledge 25, General Science 25, Mathematics 25, Reasoning 25).
Har question 1 mark ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.25 marks katenge.
Official CEE GD pattern 50 questions ka hota hai; yeh extended full-length practice set hai.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The Treaty of Sugauli (1816) was signed between British India and which country?
questions.explanation: Treaty of Sugauli ended the Anglo-Nepalese War and fixed the Nepal-India boundary.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Who was the founder of the Mamluk (Slave) Dynasty?
questions.explanation: Qutb-ud-din Aibak established the Slave Dynasty in 1206.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Doctrine of Lapse was introduced by:
questions.explanation: Lord Dalhousie used the Doctrine of Lapse to annex several Indian states.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Longest river flowing entirely within India is:
questions.explanation: Godavari is the longest river confined wholly to Indian territory.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Silent Valley National Park is in:
questions.explanation: Silent Valley is a biodiversity-rich park in Kerala’s Nilgiri hills.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The idea of Judicial Review is taken from:

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Article 32 of the Indian Constitution deals with:
questions.explanation: Article 32 is the Right to Constitutional Remedies, called the heart and soul of the Constitution.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Maximum strength of Lok Sabha is:

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Operation Meghdoot was related to:
questions.explanation: Operation Meghdoot (1984) secured the Siachen Glacier.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Highest peacetime gallantry award is:
questions.explanation: Ashoka Chakra is the highest peacetime military decoration.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which is NOT a component of Human Development Index?

questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Tropic of Cancer passes through how many Indian states?

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: National Commission for Scheduled Castes is under:

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: India’s first indigenous aircraft carrier is:

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Poona Pact (1932) was signed between Gandhi and:
questions.explanation: Poona Pact was an agreement between Mahatma Gandhi and Dr. B.R. Ambedkar.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Southernmost point of India is:
questions.explanation: Indira Point in Great Nicobar is the southernmost point of India.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: GST was implemented in India on:
questions.explanation: Goods and Services Tax came into force on 1 July 2017.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Allocation of seats in Rajya Sabha is given in:

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Cabinet Mission of 1946 was sent by:

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Agni-V is classified as:
questions.explanation: Agni-V is an Intercontinental Ballistic Missile developed by DRDO.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Chilika Lake is located in:

questions.question: Directive Principles of State Policy are in:
questions.explanation: Part IV (Articles 36–51) contains the Directive Principles of State Policy.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: G20 Summit 2023 was hosted by:
questions.explanation: India hosted the G20 Summit in New Delhi in September 2023.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The rank of Field Marshal belongs to:
questions.explanation: Field Marshal is the highest rank in the Indian Army.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: SI unit of electric field intensity is:
questions.explanation: Electric field is measured in Newton per Coulomb or Volt per metre.

questions.question: Total internal reflection is the principle behind:

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Escape velocity from Earth is approximately:

questions.question: Formula of bleaching powder is:

questions.subject: General Science

questions.subject: General Science

questions.subject: General Science

questions.question: Enzyme responsible for fat digestion is:

questions.subject: General Science

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Dimensional formula of Planck’s constant is:

questions.subject: General Science

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Site of photosynthesis in plant cell is:

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: SI unit of power is:
questions.explanation: Power is the rate of doing work; its SI unit is Watt.

questions.explanation: Zn + H₂SO₄ → ZnSO₄ + H₂↑

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Largest gland in the human body is:
questions.explanation: Liver is the largest gland and the largest internal organ.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Sound cannot travel through:

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: pH of pure water at 25°C is:
questions.explanation: Pure water is neutral and has pH 7 at 25°C.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Vitamin produced in skin by sunlight is:
questions.explanation: Vitamin D is synthesised in the skin on exposure to sunlight.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Planets revolve around the Sun due to:
questions.explanation: Gravitational force provides the necessary centripetal force.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Which of the following is a noble gas?
questions.explanation: Argon belongs to Group 18 (noble gases).

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Structural and functional unit of kidney is:
questions.explanation: Nephron is the functional unit of the kidney.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Speed of light in vacuum is:
questions.explanation: Speed of light in vacuum is 3 × 10⁸ metres per second.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Heating of carbonate ore in limited air is called:
questions.explanation: Calcination is the heating of carbonate ores in the absence or limited supply of air.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Which of the following is a communicable disease?
questions.explanation: Tuberculosis is an infectious disease caused by bacteria.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Instrument used to measure electric current is:
questions.explanation: Ammeter measures current and is connected in series.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A sum doubles itself in 8 years at simple interest. In how many years will it become four times?
questions.explanation: SI = P in 8 years ⇒ R = 12.5%. For four times, SI = 3P. Time = (3×100)/12.5 = 24 years.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If the price of sugar increases by 25%, by what percent must consumption be reduced to keep expenditure the same?
questions.explanation: New price = 125. Required consumption = 100/125 × 100 = 80. Reduction = 20%.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The ratio of ages of A and B is 3:5. After 6 years the ratio becomes 2:3. Present age of A is:
questions.explanation: Let ages be 3x and 5x. (3x+6)/(5x+6)=2/3 ⇒ 9x+18=10x+12 ⇒ x=6. A = 18 years.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A can finish a work in 12 days and B in 18 days. Working together for 4 days, what fraction of the work is left?
questions.explanation: Together 1 day = 5/36. In 4 days = 20/36 = 5/9. Left = 4/9.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A 120 m long train running at 54 km/h crosses a platform in 20 seconds. Length of the platform is:
questions.explanation: Speed = 15 m/s. Distance covered = 300 m. Platform length = 300 − 120 = 180 m.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: An article is bought for ₹400 and sold at a loss of 10%. At what price should it have been sold to gain 10%?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: Average of 5 numbers is 28. If one number is excluded, the average becomes 25. The excluded number is:
questions.explanation: Sum of 5 = 140. Sum of 4 = 100. Excluded number = 40.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A number is increased by 20% and then decreased by 20%. The net change is:
questions.explanation: 100 → 120 → 96. Net decrease of 4%.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A man walks at 5 km/h and runs at 10 km/h. He covers 30 km in 4 hours partly walking and partly running. Distance walked is:
questions.explanation: Let walking distance = x. x/5 + (30−x)/10 = 4 ⇒ 2x + 30 − x = 40 ⇒ x = 10 km.

questions.question: Area of a circle is 154 cm². Its circumference is (π = 22/7):
questions.explanation: πr² = 154 ⇒ r = 7 cm. Circumference = 2πr = 44 cm.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: Volume of a cube is 125 cm³. Its total surface area is:
questions.explanation: Side = 5 cm. Surface area = 6 × 25 = 150 cm².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: LCM of 12, 18 and 24 is:
questions.explanation: LCM of 12, 18 and 24 is 72.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: HCF of 36 and 84 is:
questions.explanation: HCF of 36 and 84 is 12.

questions.question: A invests ₹5000 and B invests ₹8000. After 6 months A invests ₹2000 more. Profit after one year is ₹6300. A’s share is:
questions.explanation: A’s capital-months = 72000, B’s = 96000. Ratio 3:4. A’s share = 3/7 × 6300 = ₹2700.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: In what ratio must water be mixed with milk costing ₹20/litre to get a mixture worth ₹15/litre?
questions.explanation: By alligation, water : milk = (20−15) : (15−0) = 5:15 = 1:3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A pipe fills a tank in 6 hours. With a leak it takes 8 hours. The leak alone can empty the tank in:
questions.explanation: 1/6 − 1/8 = 1/24. Leak empties the tank in 24 hours.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: 60% of 40% of a number is 96. The number is:
questions.explanation: 0.24 × number = 96 ⇒ number = 400.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: 12 men complete a work in 18 days. After 6 days, 4 more men join. How many more days are needed to finish the work?
questions.explanation: Total work = 216 man-days. Done = 72. Remaining = 144. With 16 men, days = 9.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If MOTHER is coded as NPUIFS, how is FATHER coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is increased by 1. FATHER → GBUIFS.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Next number in the series 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ? is:
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 2 each time: +4, +6, +8, +10, +12. Next = 42.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Book : Author :: Painting : ?
questions.explanation: A book is created by an author; a painting is created by an artist.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Pointing to a man, a woman said, “His mother is the only daughter of my mother.” How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: The only daughter of the woman’s mother is the woman herself. Hence she is the man’s mother.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A man walks 5 km North, then 3 km East, then 5 km South. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: He is 3 km East of the starting point.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: All dogs are animals. Some animals are cats. Conclusion: Some cats are animals.
questions.explanation: Some animals are cats implies some cats are animals. The conclusion follows.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the odd one out: 3, 5, 7, 9, 11
questions.explanation: 9 is not a prime number; the others are prime.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a row of 40 students, A is 15th from the left and B is 20th from the right. Number of students between A and B is:
questions.explanation: B’s position from left = 21. Students between 15 and 21 = 5.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: At what time between 3 and 4 o’clock are the hands of a clock together?
questions.explanation: They coincide at (3 × 5) × 12/11 = 16 4/11 minutes past 3.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: 15 August 1947 was a:
questions.explanation: 15 August 1947 fell on a Friday.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If DELHI is coded as EFMIJ, how is BOMBAY coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter +1. BOMBAY → CPNCBZ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Complete the series: AZ, BY, CX, DW, ?
questions.explanation: First letter increases by 1, second decreases by 1. Next is EV.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : ?
questions.explanation: A doctor works in a hospital; a teacher works in a school.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A is B’s sister. C is B’s mother. D is C’s father. How is A related to D?
questions.explanation: A is the granddaughter of D.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a code language, if ‘PEN’ is written as ‘QFO’, how is ‘INK’ written?
questions.explanation: Each letter +1. INK → JOL.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the missing number: 5, 11, 23, 47, ?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If South-East becomes North, North-East becomes West, then West becomes:
questions.explanation: The directions have been rotated 135° anti-clockwise. West becomes South-East.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the odd one out: Square, Circle, Triangle, Rectangle
questions.explanation: Circle has no sides; the others are polygons.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Ravi is 7th from the left and 15th from the right in a row. How many students are there in the row?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If ‘CAT’ is coded as ‘3120’, how is ‘DOG’ coded?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Flower : Bud :: Plant : ?
questions.explanation: A flower develops from a bud; a plant develops from a seed.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If A is the son of B, B is the daughter of C, and C is the wife of D, how is D related to A?
questions.explanation: D is the husband of C, who is the mother of B. Hence D is the maternal grandfather of A.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Next term in the series 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ?
questions.explanation: These are squares of natural numbers: 1², 2², 3², 4², 5², 6² = 36.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A person starts from point A, walks 10 m East, then 10 m North, then 10 m West. How far and in which direction is he from A?
questions.explanation: He is 10 m North of the starting point.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If in a certain language ‘COMPUTER’ is coded as ‘RFUVQNPC’, how is ‘MEDICINE’ coded?
questions.explanation: The word is divided into two halves and each half is reversed. MEDICINE → ENICIDEM → reverse halves give EOJDJEFM.
